artifacts.purpose: Additional real host WebDAV implementation for JVM resolution of provider helper signatures. Absent from audited official APK; not an original-product dependency or a parity claim. 0.4 selected for provider ABI and existing OkHttp 3.x compatibility.
Declared XML serializer for the additional Sardine host library; JDK StAX supplies the XML runtime. No Android XML stub or no-op interface.

scope: Additional real JVM host library; source APK has no Sardine definitions or declared dependency. Provider WebDAV helper ABI matches this library; current actual source execution remains a separate NAS validation.
